description: 3 positives (1 de) + 2 near-misses + 1 counterexample. Positives all ask for the decisions to be WRITTEN DOWN so a later session does not re-derive them — which is what DESIGN.md and PRODUCT.md are. The near-misses are the two neighbours that read or apply a design system rather than capture one: auditing an existing UI, and emitting token files. The counterexample guards the word 'document' outside design.
